g.text: Provisional screen | Annual baseline plus three complete interim arrows | Research cutoff: 25 October 2026
Arrows: annual baseline → matched trailing earnings and new balance sheet. Four margin trends assessed; 20 remain unknown.
Colours flag evidence, not default probabilities. Positive cash/earnings ≠ verified healthy. Capex gaps can reflect investment, not distress.
Fiscal dates differ (June 2025–September 2026). Lease accounting, asset values and cash-flow classifications limit comparability.
EBITDAR and liquidity-based credit mapping still need reconciled inputs. Sources and individual dates: risk_map.json and the evidence register.
